messages:
olivia: Heads-up — noticed a drift between the ingest shard offsets and the billing aggregator for embedding jobs from last night. Ingest logs show ~62,134 embeds, billing shows ~50,183 (delta ~11,951). Did a quick sanity check, looks like a shard rollover around 02:13 UTC.

kevin: Ugh. I saw a few shard resets in the ingest consumer at 02:12-02:15. Consumer bounced on node i-0a3 due to OOM, restarted and resumed without reprocessing the tail. Will pull logs.

samir: Can you paste the consumer restart log? We have a short window where offsets are committed but the aggregator might have skipped duplicates detection. If the restart caused the tail to be lost, that explains the undercount.

kevin: Pasting trimmed logs:
```
[2026-03-22T02:12:39Z] consumer-embed-1 ERROR OOM, killing process
[2026-03-22T02:12:40Z] systemd: restarting consumer-embed-1
[2026-03-22T02:13:02Z] consumer-embed-1 INFO resumed at offset 9481734 (shard 7)
[2026-03-22T02:13:05Z] ingest-producer INFO end-of-batch marker seq=9481799
```

kevin: Looks like the consumer resumed mid-batch. The producer committed end-of-batch later. The aggregator subscribes to the commit stream; if it reads commit after restart without replay semantics it could miss ~batch_size worth.

jonathan: Double-checking model-side batching — typical embed batch ~512 to 1024 per request. 11,951 delta / ~800 avg ~15 requests, so consistent with a single lost group of commits during the restart window.

maria: If we confirm this is a missed commit window, finance needs a remediation and approval for a billing backfill. What's the estimated billable units and cost impact?

samir: Estimate: 11,951 embed-units. Using current pricing for embeds tier C -> $0.0004 per embed => ~$4.78. We should also include compute for reprocessing if we backfill, ~0.5 GPU-hours at $2.50/hr => $1.25. Total ~ $6.03.

olivia: That cost seems small, but we need to be careful about precedent. Proposed fix: 1) reprocess the missing offsets with idempotent replay (no duplicate billing), 2) patch consumer to ensure commits are checkpointed after durable ack to aggregator, 3) add alert when consumer restarts during active batches.

maria: Approve backfill <= $20 charge for customer-facing reconciliation. Please include PR with postmortem to the billing runbook.

billing-bot: Noted. Creating billing ticket FIN-2026-243 and tagging invoices window 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z.

kevin: I'll open an infra PR to make commit semantics atomic w/ aggregator ack. Also will schedule a small reprocess job scoped to shard 7 offsets 9481730..9481800.

jonathan: Will add an eval to ensure no dup embeddings get counted (checksum on payload) before issuing billable increment.

olivia: Sounds good. Action items: kevin -> infra PR + reprocess job; samir -> run cost calc and confirm compute allocation; jonathan -> dedupe check; maria -> close finance ticket after backfill applied. Ping here when done :thumbsup:

maria: Will do. Please cc finance@redwood if any invoice adjustments are needed.
